methodAndBranches.maximum: For each actual printed first expression √n−t with n7/11/14 and t0/1, √n>2 so it exceeds1. Second expression is strictly between0and1 because √3>√2,√3<2,√2>1. Fourth c−√n<1 since c≤3 and√n>2. Hence first is unique maximum.
